definitions.explanation: A deep, dark shade of brown resembling the color of something scorched. Literally 'burnt brown.' Used for colors of clothing, hair, furniture, and other items.

examples.japanese: {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}の{革靴|かわぐつ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought dark brown leather shoes.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{髪|かみ}を{焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}に{染|そ}めた。
examples.english: She dyed her hair dark brown.

examples.japanese: {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ}の{木|き}のテーブルが{部屋|へや}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}に{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: The dark brown wooden table matches the atmosphere of the room.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ} with the same meaning. Functions as a の-adjective when modifying nouns: {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}の{鞄|かばん} (a dark brown bag). Part of the traditional Japanese color system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ} (dark brown — extended form)
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}の{髪|かみ} (dark brown hair)
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}の{革|かわ} (dark brown leather)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶色|ちゃいろ}: brown — the standard, lighter brown
- {栗色|くりいろ}: chestnut brown — a warm, reddish-brown shade
